name: Bay Club Gateway
body_markdown: Bay Club Gateway is the downtown private-pool option: outdoor water, fitness facilities, tennis, and a club environment near the Embarcadero.

access.access_summary: Bay Club Gateway is a private club in the San Francisco Campus with an outdoor aquatic center and two heated pools. Access depends on Bay Club membership, guest privileges, or a scheduled club visit.
access_notes: Use the official club page or class calendar before going; lane availability is not published in Swim Francisco yet.

pricing.label: Member
pricing.note: Bay Club does not publish a stable single-visit lap-swim price on this club page.

pricing.note: The club page offers a visit/contact flow.
